newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $10-$15 a tonne higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $10-$15 a tonne higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $10 to $15 a tonne firmer on Wednesday, dealers said.
CSCE cocoa futures settled higher on Tuesday amid featureless trade, as light speculative buying and arbitrage transactions against the London market drove the market.
Benchmark July rose $9 a tonne to close at $1,449, while spot May climbed $13 to $1,425 a tonne.
LIFFE cocoa futures firmed by the midday break on Wednesday, buoyed by trade buying. May rose 10 stg to 1,016 stg per tonne while July stood 10 stg higher to 1,024 stg per tonne.
